help: generate every parser that is absent, regenerate every one that differs from what antlr4 generates from its grammar now, and remove what the grammar no longer generates; silent when current (refused loudly under CORPUS_YOGA_NO_SEND)

does: runs antlr4-tools, which fetches antlr4-4.13.2-complete.jar into ~/.m2 on the tool's first use, then generates the parsers on the machine's java
